source.author: verg
source.text: Sic, sic iuvat ire sub umbras:
source.text_english: Thus, thus it is sweet to go down beneath the shades:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: sic ecce meus, sic orbe peracto Liber et expertus terras remeavit Apollo.
reuse.text_original: sic ecce meus, sic orbe peracto / Liber et expertus terras remeavit Apollo.
reuse.text_english: Thus, behold, my own, thus, when the circuit of the world had been completed, Liber and Apollo, having tested the lands, returned.
